name: Polynomial.coeffList_C
script:

intro hx
have h_support : (Polynomial.C x).support = {0} := by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro n
  simp only [Polynomial.mem_support_iff, Polynomial.coeff_C, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · -- Prove the forward direction: if (C x).coeff n ≠ 0, then n = 0
    intro h
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · -- If n = 0, we are done
      simp_all
    · -- If n ≠ 0, then (C x).coeff n = 0, which contradicts h
      have h₁ : (Polynomial.C x).coeff n = 0 := by
        simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, hn]
      simp_all
  · -- Prove the reverse direction: if n = 0, then (C x).coeff n ≠ 0
    intro h
    rw [h]
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, hx]

have h_coeffList : (Polynomial.C x).coeffList = [x] := by
  rw [Polynomial.coeffList]
  rw [h_support]
  -- Now we need to show that the map of the function over {0} is [x]
  simp [Finset.map_singleton, Polynomial.coeff_C]
  <;>
  aesop

exact h_coeffList

  <;>
